contexts: District with many adults lacking a regular dentist
Triage line available for 12 months from January 2027
Monthly coded data from one clinical system
reading: Prescribing for dental pain is driven by lack of dental access and fear of missing infection rather than by expected benefit, which trials show is absent when dental treatment is given. A pathway that supplies same-day dental advice addresses the driver directly. The main risk is that fewer antibiotics could delay treatment of spreading infection, so emergency attendance must be watched. Deprivation shapes both dental access and prescribing.
